notes: The canonical home https://dealertrack.com/ redirected to a Cox Automotive login page (thin, 32 characters) and is listed in needs_browser_read, though a browser read may show the same login; the vendor's marketing site is us.dealertrack.com (an alias domain in page-candidates), where five own pages were read, all HTTP 200 and not thin, three of them the pages the answers cite or link to. Judgement calls: (1) C04 headquarters is classed wrong because the footer of Dealertrack's own DMS page gives 'HEADQUARTERS COX AUTOMOTIVE ... ATLANTA, GA'; a reviewer may read that as the parent's address and prefer unverifiable. No page dates a move, so stale is not available. Cause tracing for C04 read the cited CB Insights, Sumble, DigitalDealershipSystem and DemandLocal pages (none carries the New Hyde Park statement; Sumble carries 'Dealertrack (now part of Cox Automotive)'); the cited Owler page failed with a network timeout and was not retried, so the cause is recorded as not found. (2) Partner counts 350+ and 360+ (C07, C08) are unverifiable against the vendor's '275+ certified partners' because both figures are lower bounds. (3) 'Backed by', 'powered by' and 'part of Cox Automotive' lines are coded as ownership (C01), and '(Cox Automotive)' name pairings as X-by-Y naming (C02), mirroring the vendor's own 'Dealertrack DMS by Cox Automotive'. The 'now part of Cox Automotive' lines were not coded as an acquisition because no page read documents one. Passages about DealerCenter's RouteOne/Dealertrack lender access were not coded (statements about another vendor). Out of scope: G2 ratings, 'easiest-to-use' rankings, 'started as an F&I platform', Cox Automotive's own 40,000-client count. Pass 2 (8 Oct 2026): https://dealertrack.com/ was read once in a real browser (key 9cdaf0b764413b95.browser); it redirected through the Cox login host to the us.dealertrack.com home page and was removed from needs_browser_read. It states Cox Automotive backing, a cloud-based DMS and 'over 375 OEMs and 1,500 lenders', which settles none of the unverifiable claims (375 OEMs is not an integration-partner count, so C07 and C08 stay unverifiable). Consistency check: C04 (New Hyde Park headquarters) is re-classed from wrong to unverifiable, because the footer address is labelled as Cox Automotive's headquarters and no page says Dealertrack is headquartered there; judgement call (1) above is superseded, and the cause tracing it describes no longer applies. Completeness: one new claim, C21 'pricing is not publicly listed' (dealership-management-systems|q2|Claude|1), unverifiable. The other gap lines and table cells are about other vendors, opinions, feature descriptions, ratings, or repeat claims already listed for the same answer (cloud, Cox integrations, custom quote).
